name: Creamy Sundried Tomato & Spinach Linguine Pasta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (1 quarter coin = 57 g) linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 cloves garlic
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion, garlic, tomatoes, and crushed red pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce, basil, salt, and pepper to pan. Stir to combine and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
¾ tsp basil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
Add yogurt to pan, reduce heat to medium-low, and stir to combine.
Add spinach and fold in until wilted. Remove pan from heat until pasta is ready.
Drain pasta in a colander, reserving about 1 ½ cup of the pasta water.
Add pasta and ½ of the water to sauce; toss to coat. If sauce is too thick, add more pasta water to thin it out.
Place pasta in a bowl or on a plate and garnish with grated Parmesan.
